description: The whole report FILE of the EMBOSS 6.6.0 programs fuzznuc, fuzzpro, fuzztran, etandem and equicktandem on a FASTA text of one or several sequences (etandem / equicktandem read the first), byte for byte as the installed program writes it: every -rformat (simple embl genbank gff gff3 pir swiss dasgff debug listfile dbmotif draw restrict excel feattable motif nametable regions seqtable srs summary table tagseq; diffseq is refused: it needs 7 report tags; embl / genbank are nucleotide only, pir / swiss protein only), the header with the command line and the pattern / parameter text, one block per sequence, the totals footer, the report options -raccshow -rdesshow -rscoreshow -rstrandshow -rusashow -rmaxall -rmaxseq, the sequence qualifiers -sbegin -send -sreverse and the extra -origfile text of etandem / equicktandem (originalFile). reportQualifiers is the text after the files, e.g. '-rformat table -raccshow -rmaxseq 2'; the default format is seqtable (fuzznuc, fuzzpro) or table (fuzztran, etandem, equicktandem). Delegates to EmbossReportPrograms and the one EmbossReportWriter.

fasta.description: The input file text: FASTA records (name = first word of the header, an accession-like second word is the accession, the rest the description).

pattern.description: The pattern (fuzznuc / fuzzpro / fuzztran -pattern); give this or patternFile.

maxMismatches.description: fuzznuc / fuzzpro / fuzztran -pmismatch (a pattern file entry <mismatch=n> overrides it).

patternFile.description: The TEXT of a pattern file (-pattern @file; A5-8c): one pattern per line, or FASTA style (>name, optionally '<mismatch=n>' after the name, then the pattern); every pattern is a row of the header table and has its own features.

patternName.description: -pname: the pattern name (default 'pattern'; the lines of a simple file are numbered after it).

patternFormat.description: -pformat: simple (one pattern per line) or fasta; default: decided by the first line of the file.

sequenceQualifiers.description: Sequence qualifiers as typed after the files: -sbegin 3 -send -2 -sreverse -slower -supper.

reportQualifiers.description: Report qualifiers as typed after the files: -rformat table -raccshow -rdesshow -rscoreshow -rstrandshow -rusashow -rmaxall 5 -rmaxseq 2 (negated booleans -norscoreshow).

commandLine.description: The command-line entries printed in the report header, one per line (e.g. '[-sequence] s.fa', '-pattern ACGT'); default: synthesized from the parameters.

runDate.description: The run date of the header (ISO 8601); default now.

fastaFile.description: The input file name: sequence USAs read fasta::NAME:id (default sequence.fasta).

reportFile.description: The report file name printed in the header (default stdout).

errors.message: Report format 'embl' not supported for protein sequences
Report format 'diffseq' needs 7 tags, has only 2
